text:
sara_ae: Heads-up: Acme POC hitting 403s on generate. Error in their logs says org mismatch. Can someone from eng take a quick look?
sara_ae: Customer: Jane (Acme). We issued a key last week. env they call is acme-prod.
jane_acme: Posting the error we see: 
```
POST /v1/generate 403
{"error":"invalid_organization_claim", "message":"token org claim 'acme-internal' does not match request header 'acme-prod'"}
request_id=01KZ9Y8ABCDEF0001
```
matt_eng: thanks. Are they sending any X-Redwood headers?
sara_ae: yes, they add X-Redwood-Org: acme-prod per their dev, but the key was created under acme-internal in our system.
matt_eng: that would do it. Tokens are org-bound by default. Two quick fixes: 1) create a key for acme-prod, or 2) have them drop the X-Redwood-Org header so the token's claim is used.
matt_eng: can you paste the curl they run?
jane_acme: curl snippet: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-prod" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
(note: their key string starts with sk_prod_ but it's tied to acme-internal)
infra-bot: error-code: INVALID_ORG_CLAIM. guidance: token org claim mismatch with request header.
matt_eng: easiest for POC: create a project-scoped key bound to acme-prod and limit qps. I'll spin one up now.
matt_eng: sara_ae: do you want project or org scope?
sara_ae: project-scoped (they only need a single project). QPS cap 50. TTL 30d for now.
ana_se: security note: customer asked if tokens can be rotated and about short-lived service account creds. We should mention service-account pattern + KMS.
ana_se: @sara_ae forward their security questionnaire and I'll fill rotation/KMS items.
sara_ae: sent questionnaire link in DM and attached.
matt_eng: created key: sk_proj_ACMEWEB_9b2d (project: acme-web, org: acme-prod, qps:50, ttl:30d). Advise switch to this key or remove X-Redwood-Org header.
jane_acme: testing now with new key and same header.
jane_acme: Success ✅ no 403s. integration smoke passed.
oliver_sales: Pricing Q: post-POC qps spike — ballpark for Dedicated? Link: https://redwood.ai/pricing. Rough: small dedicated pool ~ $12k/mo but depends on GPU and SLO. I'll loop in AE for exact quote.
sara_ae: thanks. Next actions: oliver follow-up on pricing, ana finish questionnaire, matt add runbook note to make error remediation clearer.
matt_eng: added runbook todo: when INVALID_ORG_CLAIM occurs, surface clear remediation steps (rotate key, remove header, or request tenant-scoped key).
sara_ae: Jane, can you confirm final smoke test timestamp?
jane_acme: done at 1876543275. All good from our side, thanks team! :tada:
